EntityLocation.description: Where an entity lives: the tenant (organization) it belongs to, and the teams that can see and change it. The rights of the admins are checked against it

tenant.description: The id of the tenant (organization) of the entity

teams.description: The ids of the teams of the entity. `*` stands for every team of the tenant (organization)

MtlsConfig.description: The tls settings of the calls otoroshi makes to a remote server: the client certificates it presents, and the certificates it trusts

certs.description: The ids of the certificates of otoroshi presented as client certificates when `mtls` is true. A certificate can also be designated by its distinguished name, the valid one expiring last is then used

items.description: The id or the distinguished name of a certificate

trustedCerts.description: The ids of the certificates of otoroshi trusted to validate the certificate of the remote server, on top of the default trust store

mtls.description: Use these tls settings for the calls. When false, the default tls settings of otoroshi are used. The legacy `tls` key is read too

loose.description: Do not check the host name of the certificate of the remote server

trustAll.description: Trust any certificate of the remote server. For tests only

WSProxyServer.description: An http proxy the calls of otoroshi go through. It is only used when its host and its port are set

host.description: The host name or the ip address of the proxy. A blank host disables the proxy, the calls are then direct

port.description: The port the proxy listens on. Without a port, the proxy is not used

protocol.description: The protocol used to talk to the proxy, `http` when null

principal.description: The user to authenticate on the proxy

password.description: The password to authenticate on the proxy

ntlmDomain.description: The NTLM domain of the user, for a proxy using NTLM authentication

encoding.description: The charset of the credentials sent to the proxy

nonProxyHosts.description: The hosts called directly, without the proxy, compared without case: a host name, or a pattern with a `*` at its start or at its end (`*.internal.oto.tools`, `10.0.*`)

items.description: A host or a host pattern
